    Binary biproducts of short complexes #

    Two short complexes in a category with zero morphisms have a componentwise binary direct sum, provided the three relevant binary biproducts exist. This file constructs it and records the projection lemmas identifying its objects and maps.

    Main definitions #

    • LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.shortComplexBiprod: the componentwise binary direct sum of two short complexes.

    Implementation notes #

    shortComplexBiprod is @[expose]d so that its objects are definitionally the corresponding biproducts outside this file. Without that, the type of (shortComplexBiprod S₁ S₂).f could not be seen to be S₁.X₁ ⊞ S₂.X₁ ⟶ S₁.X₂ ⊞ S₂.X₂, and the projection lemmas for the two maps would have to be stated with a heterogeneous equality.
